value.rationale: The homogeneous quadratic equations of the reduced embedded toric complex are intrinsic, and the original literature provides only a zero-set description. The result gives a complete invariant linear subspace and an explicit uniform minimal-degree basis, locating a sharp onset at n=5 and an unbounded defect binomial(n-1,4) in a natural presentation. It does not trade novelty for a routine n=5 example: the theorem holds uniformly for all n>=4 and distinguishes two notions of defining equations.
